```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bike_bom AS (
    -- start from Mountain Bikes and their current top-level BOM components
    SELECT p.product_id AS root_product_id,
           bom.component_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory sc ON p.subcategory_id = sc.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category c ON sc.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE c.name = 'Bikes'
      AND sc.name = 'Mountain Bikes'
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')

    UNION ALL

    -- recurse through subassemblies
    SELECT bb.root_product_id,
           bom.component_id
    FROM bike_bom bb
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = bb.component_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bb.root_product_id) AS bike_count
FROM bike_bom bb
JOIN product comp ON comp.product_id = bb.component_id
WHERE comp.product_number = 'CB-2903';
```
